name: readtune
description: A Chrome extension that suggests reading settings worth trying, then applies them everywhere — articles, PDFs, and web pages.

scripts.test: npm run check && npm run capture-privacy-check && npm run relay-error-check && npm run piper-recovery-check && npm run dictation-privacy-check && npm run pdf-load-guard-check && npm run relay-privacy-policy-check && npm run reader-privacy-lifecycle-check && npm run screen-lifecycle-check && npm run summary-context-check && npm run relay-fairness-check && npm run site-security-check && npm run privacy-copy-check && npm run harness
